name: Bayley Wang
bio: Bayley is the visionary behind PrismaX, leading the company's mission to bring physical AI into the real world. A builder at heart, they believe the next frontier of intelligence lives in the physical layer.
why_joined: To build the physical layer of intelligence.
messageToFuture: The machines we build today will remember us by the intentions we poured into them. Build with care.

name: Chyna Qu
bio: Chyna architects the operational engine of PrismaX. Where strategy meets execution, she ensures the vision translates into systems that scale.
why_joined: Because great operations are what turn vision into reality.
messageToFuture: Precision in the present is the greatest gift you can give to the future.

name: Shaye Backus
bio: Shaye drives the growth engine of PrismaX, finding new ways to connect the product with the people who need it most. Growth, for her, is about creating genuine value at scale.
why_joined: Growth is about finding the people who need this most.
messageToFuture: Every person you bring along on the journey becomes part of what you leave behind.

name: Vivian
bio: Vivian orchestrates the marketing operations of PrismaX, ensuring every campaign, channel, and story lands with intention. She believes great marketing is just great storytelling.
why_joined: Stories are how humans make sense of the future.
messageToFuture: The stories we tell now become the myths of tomorrow. Make them worth remembering.
